title: Virtual Acoustic Object (VAO) Standard: Version 0.6.0
description: Version 0.6.0 of the Virtual Acoustic Object Standard integrates Mechanical Music Information Carriers (MMICs) through the independently versioned MMIC 1.0.0 application profile and a VAO-owned mechanical-music vocabulary. It adds documentary, decoding, comparison and generation conformance; native gate, impulse, latch and envelope signals; explicit MIDI bindings; complete operational model identity; geometric and timing consistency; qualified playback alignment; immutable corrections; and separate design/fabrication lineage. The release includes JSON Schema, JSON-LD, RDF and SHACL resources, offline validation, bounded processing, reference implementations, synthetic examples and byte-preserving 0.5-to-0.6 migration. The 0.5.0 specification, schemas, readers and fixtures remain unchanged. Specification and semantic resources are CC BY 4.0; reference software, tests and automation are Apache-2.0; new MMIC synthetic data is CC0-1.0, with code and dependency-lock exceptions. REUSE.toml defines the authoritative per-file mapping. Historical accuracy and physical playability are not certified. Version 0.6.0 resolver routing is pending; the immutable GitHub release and this Zenodo version provide access to the release.
